instruction: Add a new habit tracking log note for today in my Simple Note account. It should be the same as yesterday, except I did not meditate today.
notes: Single-app task (simple_note). Yesterday's habit log is discovered via search_notes (query 'habit', static fact query-finds), its full details (title, content, tags, pinned) are read with show_note (note-details-known), and today's note is created with create_note using the derived values: same title/header with today's date, same tags and pinned status, same content except the meditation entry marked as not done. Static facts title-for-today/content-for-today/tags-of/pinned-of tie the derived values to the template note so the planner can only create the correct note. Since the task asks no question, supervisor-complete-task carries no API arguments; its parameters are only the created record and its attributes so its precondition mirrors the goal. The goal demands exactly one new note with matching title, content, tags and pinned status, and no other note changes (no update/delete actions exist in the domain).

plan: (simple-note-create-note title-habit-log-today content-today-did-not-meditate simple-note-token tags-of-yesterday-log pinned-of-yesterday-log habit-log-today habit-log-yesterday)
